name: Norway maple
light_note: Tolerates part shade while young; at maturity it wants full light.

name: Persian silk tree
light_note: In shade the crown gets sparse and it rarely flowers.

name: Hazel
light_note: Grows in part shade too, but fruits well only with sun on the crown.

name: Fig
light_note: The warmest, most sheltered spot in the garden — next to a south-facing wall is ideal.

name: Apple
light_note: Fruits on wood that gets sun — which is why the crown is thinned by pruning.

name: Cornelian cherry
light_note: Copes well with the forest edge — part shade doesn't bother it.

name: Sea buckthorn
light_note: Without direct sun it doesn't fruit at all.

name: Red currant
light_note: In our climate it prefers part shade: in direct sun the leaves scorch and the fruit ripens small.

name: Black currant
light_note: Needs moist soil; afternoon shade helps it through summer.

name: White currant
light_note: White variety of red currant — same species, same care; prefers a part-shaded spot.

name: Gooseberry
light_note: Part shade protects it from powdery mildew and fruit scorch.

name: Grapevine
light_note: Grapes ripen only with a south or south-west exposure.

name: Nectarine
light_note: Like the peach: sun all day, otherwise leaf curl becomes chronic.

name: Black chokeberry
light_note: Fruits more heavily in sun, but tolerates part shade.

name: Smoke tree
light_note: The autumn colour and the "smoke" of flower heads appear only in sun.

name: Rose of Sharon
light_note: In shade it hardly flowers.

name: Red tip photinia
light_note: The red shoots are more intense in sun; part shade keeps them greener.

name: Lilac
light_note: Below 5–6 hours of sun, flowering visibly declines year after year.

name: Forsythia
light_note: In shade it makes long shoots and few flowers.

name: Privet
light_note: Works in part shade too — which is why it's good as a hedge on the north side.

name: Japanese kerria
light_note: One of the few shrubs that flower in shade; in direct sun the flowers fade.

name: Rose 'de Rescht'
light_note: Below 6 hours of sun it makes few flowers and gets black spot.

name: Lavender
light_note: In shade it sprawls, doesn't flower and rots at the collar.

name: Rosemary
light_note: Full sun and drainage — these are requirements, not preferences.

name: Sage
light_note: The aroma is stronger in sun and on poor soil.

name: Lemon balm
light_note: In summer, afternoon shade keeps the leaves tender.

name: Comfrey
light_note: Tolerates the shade under trees too — which is why it's good as a mulch plant there.

name: Shrubby cinquefoil
light_note: Flowers all season only in direct sun.
